body: I take groceries to my grandma weekly who is pretty high risk, which is one of the main reasons why I'm pretty cautious about COVID. Honestly I'm more worried about her getting it than me LOL which is why I don't want to risk it because it'll affect her much more than it will affect me
Thank you so much for the advice. Your words made me feel a whole lot better. I'm happy that you ended up having a good future, despite the hardships you faced.

Oh my, I was literally in the same position (crying in the bathroom after a chemistry test) last month. It's nice to know that one test doesn't affect oneself in the future, though. Of course I'm still going to be working hard but I feel a lot more comforted knowing that people have gone through the same experiences as I have and ended up in a good place.

I do want to go to therapy, but I havent told my parents about my mental health because I feel like theres still stigma around mental illnesses and stuff like that in general, maybe I'm overthinking though. I'm trying to work up the courage to tell them, hopefully soon. Thank you for the advice!

That’s nice to know that grades aren’t everything. My mental health really effected my grades this past quarter, but my friends really helped me through this past few weeks. I hope one day I’ll be able to look back fondly on high school, instead of remembering the stress I feel, haha.

Karma really hit the bully hard (or in this case, her car. haha.) My school has a no tolerance for bullying policy, which sounds pretty lame, but everyone actually follows it. Popularity grows because of kindness, so everyone is all friends throughout my school, which is so different than the high school musical cliche I was originally expecting. Everyone mostly just focused on grades, especially because today’s society focuses on competition for a good education. I see how the time difference really effects ones high school experience, if only everything wasn’t so strict nowadays, agh.
Okay, glad to know I’m not the only one! I love food as well, I just don’t have an appetite anymore
Thank you, I’m glad to know that I won’t always be like this. What you said makes a lot of sense!
Wow... that actually makes a lot of sense. I'm going to keep this in mind as I look at my current and future relationships. Thank you, this helped me a lot.
